ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: What is represented by letter B?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: This is a schematic diagram of plant photosynthesis. The plant grows in soil, with its roots underground; in the upper left there is sunlight shining, labeled C; near the soil and roots there is a blue water area, labeled A; on the right side of the plant there is a blue arrow pointing outward from near the leaves, labeled D; on the left side of the plant there is a light-colored arrow pointing from the direction of the air toward the leaves, with B labeled beside it. Reasoning: In photosynthesis, plants absorb carbon dioxide from the air, entering the plant through the leaves; water and sunlight are also inputs, while oxygen is usually released from the leaves. In the picture, B is the arrow entering the leaves from the air, so B represents carbon dioxide.
